Less than 24 hours after going live, Apple removes support document for "Apple Intelligence with Qwen" — response arrives
August 9 news — According to reports, Apple's China website Mac section had previously published a usage guide stating that mainland China's Apple Intelligence could integrate with Alibaba's Qwen large model, leading the market to believe that Apple's AI features for mainland China were about to launch. However, the document was removed by the official site in less than a day, with only the Apple Intelligence with ChatGPT instructions remaining on the website.
